title: How 3,000 Wing Beats Keep Hummingbirds Hovering

scenes.text: 3,000 wing beats per minute keep hummingbirds afloat

scenes.label: FASTEST METABOLISM IN BIRDS
scenes.text: Their tiny bodies burn calories faster than any other bird, needing to eat half their weight daily

scenes.label: SPECIALIZED WING JOINTS
scenes.text: Unique ball‑and‑socket shoulder joints let them rotate their wings 180 degrees for precise hovering

scenes.label: ENERGY‑STORING HEART
scenes.text: Their heart can beat up to 1,260 times per minute, pumping oxygen to sustain rapid wing strokes
Follow for facts that sound fake but aren't.
